name: Shizuku Filter
description: Shizuku Filter is a calm, responsive WordPress landing theme designed for small-batch maker crowdfunding campaigns. Built with full-pill capsule layouts, an 80px vertical rail, and refined sans-serif typography, it showcases products through high-key documentary photography and clear, grounded storytelling. Developed for the Shizuku Countertop Filter workshop in Rotterdam, Netherlands.
